experiment_data.hypothesis: Cheetah CIVO intensity requires higher TCN noise; σ=0.5 may be the environment-appropriate dose (Walker σ=0.5 = overdose causing oscillatory CIVO, Cheetah σ=0.2 = underdose with NVE 1.903@55K). Tests whether TCN effectiveness is environment-dependent with σ scaling to CIVO severity. If NVE<1.5× and eval maintained → TCN is generalizable with environment-tuned σ.
